label: input h at original steps 3-4, context-gated (prev q / first token r)
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit, active only in the original phase, almost always on the first occurrence of input h (94.5% of mass; b carries the remaining ~5%) at steps 3-5 (t=3,4 hold 92% of mass). It never fires in the delimiter or copy phase or at t<3 or t>6. The h-at-t3-5 condition is nearly necessary (mass recall 0.94) but far from sufficient: only ~4% of such steps fire. Which ones fire depends on the earlier context: prev token q (10x lift) and first token r/o/t raise the rate, and the largest activations are r..q h. Recorded conjunction (h at t3-4, first occurrence, prev q or first token r) gets dev F1 0.41 / mass recall 0.56; the gating looks like a nonlinear threshold over the prefix that no simple predicate captures. Magnitude is tiny overall (max 0.02).
